content_sections.heading: About CSIR-TKDL Unit
content_sections.text: The CSIR–Traditional Knowledge Digital Library Unit is located at Vigyan Suchna Bhawan, Satsang Vihar Marg, New Delhi. These positions fall under its project "The Importance of Traditional Wisdom: Environmental Consciousness in Vedic and Other Literature and its Relevance for Modern Climate Strategies – A Brief Study" (GAP-000001).

faq.question: Q1. Which disciplines are covered?
faq.answer: Forestry & Ecology (code TKEE01) and Environmental Sciences (code TKEE02), with 01 position in each.

faq.question: Q2. What time should I reach the venue?
faq.answer: The interview time for both disciplines is 9:30 AM to 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the interview held?
faq.answer: It is held on the Ground Floor of Vigyan Suchna Bhawan, 14, Satsang Vihar Marg, New Delhi – 110067.

faq.question: Q4. What should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the duly filled application form along with your supporting documents.

faq.question: Q5. Are these permanent positions?
faq.answer: No. The notice describes them as purely temporary project positions.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I find the detailed advertisement?
faq.answer: The notice says it is available on the official CSIR website, www.csir.res.in.

faq.question: Q7. How can I contact the CSIR-TKDL Unit?
faq.answer: The notice prints the telephone number 011-26851136 and the email address [email protected].
